preconditions.description: The number of beads n is between 1 and 1000000 inclusive.
The number k is between 1 and 1000000 inclusive.
The length of the beads string is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(b in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for b in beads)
preconditions.description: Each bead color in the beads string is a lowercase Latin letter.

postconditions.description: The length of the result string is equal to n.

postconditions.expression: all(r in '01' for r in result)
postconditions.description: Each character in the result string is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: result[i] == '1' if is_regular(beads[:i+1], k) else result[i] == '0' for i in range(n)
postconditions.description: Position i in the result string is '1' if the first i+1 beads form a regular sequence, otherwise '0'.
